nodes.id: docs_对话式执行方案助手实施方案_executionplan
nodes.label: ExecutionPlan Data Model
nodes.source_file: docs/对话式执行方案助手实施方案.md
nodes.description: Data model for execution plans with lifecycle state machine: draft -> need_clarification -> prechecking -> ready -> confirmed -> executing -> completed/failed/cancelled. Includes ExecutionStep, RiskItem, SuggestionItem sub-models.

nodes.id: docs_对话式执行方案助手实施方案_drafteditor
nodes.label: DraftEditor
nodes.source_file: docs/对话式执行方案助手实施方案.md
nodes.description: Immutable plan editing system with undo capability. Enables step-level modification of execution plans: edit single steps, reorder, add/remove steps, change parameters. Part of conversational execution plan assistant.

nodes.id: docs_对话式执行方案助手实施方案_pendingclarification
nodes.label: PendingClarification State
nodes.source_file: docs/对话式执行方案助手实施方案.md
nodes.description: State for handling parameter clarification追问. When required parameters are missing from user command, system enters clarification mode to collect missing information before proceeding with plan creation.
